_comment: Registered commands that production frontend code doesn't invoke, each with a reason. check-ipc.mjs --strict (run by CI) fails on any other unreferenced command and on entries that are no longer registered.

commands.generate_summary_stream: only reached through an unused hook value; becomes the one summary command in 0.2.0
commands.start_recording: legacy unsegmented mic start; unused since mic-only records through the segment commands. Removed with the 0.2.1 session commands
